item.title: All Aboard! Beach access in Washington! C. 1945. $780,000
item.description: All aboard! A Pullman car and two cabooses form this unique residence. Constructed in 1945. It is located on .83 acre in Ocean City, Washington. There are curved ceilings, original racks and a wet bar that once served passengers on the railroad. There is a detached garage, storage shed and an easement to the Pacific Ocean. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,510 square feet. $780,000 Contact Michael Morrison with Morrison House Sotheby’s International From the Zillow listing: All aboard for a

item.title: Has a pool! C. 1900 in North Carolina. $150,000
item.description: That looks like a nice pool! The house could use some work and lightening up inside. The house was built in 1900. It is located on .65 acre in Faith, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, some original wood flooring and baseboards. Getting rid of paneling and drop ceilings would really help this house. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,877 square feet. $150,000 Contact Deanna Jackson with Denali Realty and Associates: denalirealty.associates@gmail.com From the Zillow listing

item.title: Nice acreage! On 25 acres in Virginia. $235,000
item.description: This house has some nice acreage with it! Long driveway! The house was built in 1942. It is located on 25 acres in Bassett, Virginia. The house features a long driveway, covered front porch, some wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards, arched entryway, built-in bookshelves and stained glass. There is an enclosed back porch and a detached two car garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,773 square feet. $235,000 Contact the property owner: 540-294-3271 From the Zillow listing: Country Craftsma

item.title: Idaho’s most expensive old house listing! Eclectic interior! $5,495,000
item.description: Welcome to Idaho’s most expensive old house listing! The interior is eclectic! The house is bigger than it looks with over 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1944. It is located in Ketchum, Idaho. The house features mature gardens, hot tub, fully finished basement, wrap around deck and views of Bald Mountain. Three bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,124 square feet. $5,495,000 From the Zillow listing: Welcome to a truly extraordinary offering in the heart of Ketchum — a 4,474 SF legacy proper
